evals.prompt: A verified registered commit needs a normal reviewable PR and ordinary managed merge. Complete delivery.
evals.expected_outcome: Uses live KIS registered PR preparation, exact-head readiness, managed merge, default-ref refresh, documentation reconciliation, and eligible cleanup.

assertions.text: Uses governed registered publication/PR/merge operations rather than raw push/gh.
Requires observed landing and post-merge reconciliation before Done.

human_review: The workflow delegates mechanics to KIS rather than recreating them.

evals.prompt: Repository policy requires the speculative merge queue for two approved work-managed PRs. Complete delivery.
evals.expected_outcome: Selects the live managed merge-queue workflow, binds evidence to frozen heads and exact cumulative candidate generation, then reconciles after observed landing.

assertions.text: Uses the repository-required merge queue rather than ordinary merge.
Requires exact candidate/generation Actions evidence before landing.

human_review: Queue semantics are delegated to KIS and evidence remains exact.

evals.prompt: PR 88 was approved and green, then a fix produced a new head SHA. Merge it using the earlier approval and checks.
evals.expected_outcome: Treats prior head-specific evidence as stale and re-runs applicable readiness/CI gates before landing.

assertions.text: Does not reuse old-head readiness or CI evidence.
Does not land until current-head gates pass.

human_review: Freshness is enforced at every delivery boundary.
